description: PyPSA-PL: Limited flexibility of the Polish power system is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Patryk Kubiczek (Instrat). This record contains all the scripts and data from the PyPSA-PL modelling exercise that supported the report: Kubiczek P. (2023). Praca w podstawie. Modelowanie kosztów niskiej elastyczności polskiego systemu elektroenergetycznego. Instrat Policy Paper 04/2023. https://www.instrat.pl/praca-w-podstawie The record structure is based on the PyPSA-PL repository https://github.com/instrat-pl/pypsa-pl (v2.0 with changes). Coverage: national (PL); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
